Sohail Khan hosts success party for reality show 'Alliance'

Actor and producer Sohail Khan hosted a success party following the conclusion of the reality show 'Alliance'. Several celebrities attended the event, including Salman Khan, Kunal Khemu, Niti Taylor, Kushal Tandon, and Mini Mathur. Kunal Khemu, who hosted the show, shared inside pictures from the party. Salman Khan made a notable appearance at the event.
